scripts.build:cli: (taskkill /IM aj.exe /F >nul 2>&1 || echo No running aj.exe) && (taskkill /IM aj-bg.exe /F >nul 2>&1 || echo No running aj-bg.exe) && npx esbuild cli/aj.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/aj.cjs --external:enquirer && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('package.json'))fs.renameSync('package.json','package.json.bak');" && npx pkg dist/aj.cjs --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/aj.exe && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('package.json.bak'))fs.renameSync('package.json.bak','package.json');fs.mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true});if(fs.existsSync('dist/aj-bg.exe'))fs.unlinkSync('dist/aj-bg.exe');fs.copyFileSync('dist/aj.exe','dist/aj-bg.exe');if(fs.existsSync('public/aj.exe'))fs.unlinkSync('public/aj.exe');fs.copyFileSync('dist/aj.exe','public/aj.exe');if(fs.existsSync('public/aj-bg.exe'))fs.unlinkSync('public/aj-bg.exe');fs.copyFileSync('dist/aj.exe','public/aj-bg.exe');fs.copyFileSync('install_aj.ps1','public/install.ps1');" && npm run build:installer
scripts.build:installer: npx esbuild cli/install.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/install.cjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('dist/aj.exe','dist/aj.bin');if(fs.existsSync('package.json'))fs.renameSync('package.json','package.json.bak');" && npx pkg -c cli/pkg-config.json dist/install.cjs --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/install.exe && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('package.json.bak'))fs.renameSync('package.json.bak','package.json');fs.mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true});if(fs.existsSync('public/install.exe'))fs.unlinkSync('public/install.exe');fs.copyFileSync('dist/install.exe','public/install.exe');"
